findings.evidenceJa: ここで納得する訳にもいかない
findings.governingReading: ここで納得する訳にもいかない means he cannot be satisfied with or simply accept the situation at this point.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s inability to accept the explanation becomes an inability to stop Rin.

findings.highlight: Nothing happened. I declined, of course
findings.evidenceJa: 続きも何も、当然断ったわ
findings.governingReading: 続きも何も、当然断ったわ means “there is no continuation to speak of; of course I refused,” followed immediately by his continuing to press her.
findings.explanation: “Nothing happened” contradicts Rin’s account that Shinji persisted after she refused him.

findings.highlight: Stagnant, red air immediately begins suffocating everything within the school grounds
findings.evidenceJa: 吸い込むだけで意識を麻痺させようとする
findings.governingReading: The Japanese says the red air enveloping the school grounds tries to paralyze consciousness when inhaled; ordinary people then lose consciousness and eventually die.
findings.explanation: A field that numbs consciousness merely by breathing becomes stagnant air that suffocates everything.

findings.highlight: To get to the bottom of this as fast as possible
findings.evidenceJa: 一刻も早くこの事態を収拾するには
findings.governingReading: 事態を収拾する means to bring the situation under control or resolve it.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s immediate aim to resolve the crisis becomes an aim to investigate its cause.
